visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) IU walks across a golden-flecked stage wearing a grey textured gown with a black blazer over her shoulders; she waves to the crowd while confetti falls. (2) LE SSERAFIM members Kazuha and another member walk by, waving; they are dressed in white and black performance outfits. (3) The group MEOVV performs a synchronized dance routine in white and silver glittery outfits under bright blue lighting. (4) Members of IVE, including Wonyoung, perform on stage in pink outfits; they pose and smile at the camera. (5) Wonyoung and Sung Han-bin appear as MCs on a large outdoor stage, holding cue cards and microphones. (6) KISS OF LIFE performs an energetic routine in red and black streetwear-inspired outfits. (7) Boy groups including Cortis, Felix from Stray Kids, and Riize perform high-energy dance sequences with fast camera cuts. (8) Woodz performs a solo rock set, singing into a microphone while a guitarist plays behind him under a starry digital background. (9) All artists gather on the main stage for a group photo session in front of a massive cheering audience holding purple light sticks.

(2) The audio shifts to a sequence of different K-pop dance tracks with heavy electronic beats and female vocals as various groups appear. (3) A loud thud or transition SFX marks a shift to a rock performance with distorted electric guitar and powerful male vocals hitting high notes. (4) The track concludes with a massive roar of crowd applause and cheering overlaid with a bright, major-key synth pop melody.
